panels.title: p95 TTFT

panels.description: p50, p95 and p99 nearest-rank latency per adaptive bucket, successful non-cancelled calls only.
panels.noValue: No successful calls in this time range.

targets.query: WITH b AS (SELECT CAST(ts/MAX(10,(($__to-$__from)/1000)/120) AS INTEGER)*MAX(10,(($__to-$__from)/1000)/120) AS time,latency_ms,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CAST(ts/MAX(10,(($__to-$__from)/1000)/120) AS INTEGER) ORDER BY latency_ms) rn,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY CAST(ts/MAX(10,(($__to-$__from)/1000)/120) AS INTEGER)) cnt FROM calls_v WHERE ('${model:raw}'='__all' OR model IN (${model:singlequote})) AND ts BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000 AND success=1 AND is_cancelled=0) SELECT time,MAX(CASE WHEN rn=(cnt*50+99)/100 THEN latency_ms END) AS p50,MAX(CASE WHEN rn=(cnt*95+99)/100 THEN latency_ms END) AS p95,MAX(CASE WHEN rn=(cnt*99+99)/100 THEN latency_ms END) AS p99 FROM b GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
targets.queryText: WITH b AS (SELECT CAST(ts/MAX(10,(($__to-$__from)/1000)/120) AS INTEGER)*MAX(10,(($__to-$__from)/1000)/120) AS time,latency_ms,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CAST(ts/MAX(10,(($__to-$__from)/1000)/120) AS INTEGER) ORDER BY latency_ms) rn,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY CAST(ts/MAX(10,(($__to-$__from)/1000)/120) AS INTEGER)) cnt FROM calls_v WHERE ('${model:raw}'='__all' OR model IN (${model:singlequote})) AND ts BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000 AND success=1 AND is_cancelled=0) SELECT time,MAX(CASE WHEN rn=(cnt*50+99)/100 THEN latency_ms END) AS p50,MAX(CASE WHEN rn=(cnt*95+99)/100 THEN latency_ms END) AS p95,MAX(CASE WHEN rn=(cnt*99+99)/100 THEN latency_ms END) AS p99 FROM b GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Latency Percentiles Over Time

panels.description: Average and p95 latency per adaptive bucket for the top models by observed call count; successful non-cancelled calls only.
panels.noValue: No successful calls in this time range.

targets.query: WITH top AS (SELECT provider||'/'||model AS m FROM calls_v WHERE ts BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 6) SELECT CAST(ts/MAX(10,(($__to-$__from)/1000)/120) AS INTEGER)*MAX(10,(($__to-$__from)/1000)/120) AS time,provider||'/'||model AS model,AVG(latency_ms) AS avg_latency FROM calls_v WHERE ts BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000 AND success=1 AND is_cancelled=0 AND provider||'/'||model IN (SELECT m FROM top) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1
targets.queryText: WITH top AS (SELECT provider||'/'||model AS m FROM calls_v WHERE ts BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 6) SELECT CAST(ts/MAX(10,(($__to-$__from)/1000)/120) AS INTEGER)*MAX(10,(($__to-$__from)/1000)/120) AS time,provider||'/'||model AS model,AVG(latency_ms) AS avg_latency FROM calls_v WHERE ts BETWEEN $__from/1000 AND $__to/1000 AND success=1 AND is_cancelled=0 AND provider||'/'||model IN (SELECT m FROM top) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1
